# UAS imagery processing

## Outline

* What comes home from a flight: images, flight log, ground control
* Products: orthomosaic, DSM and DTM, point cloud, textured model
* Exterior and interior orientation, markers, coordinate reference systems
* The Agisoft Metashape workflow step by step, and the settings that matter
* Exports, the processing report, and which accuracy number to quote

## Lecture

* Lecture Slides: [UAS Imagery Processing](lectures/lecture_2b.qmd)

## Supplemental materials

* [Structure from Motion demo](sfm_demo.qmd): interactive flight over a terrain, showing how overlap and flying height decide which ground points are reconstructed
* [Agisoft Metashape user manual](https://www.agisoft.com/pdf/metashape-pro_2_3_en.pdf), Professional edition {{< var software.agisoft.version >}} [@agisoft_metashape_manual_2025]
* Agisoft tutorials: [orthomosaic and DEM generation with GCPs](https://agisoft.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/31000148381-orthomosaic-dem-generation-with-gcps), [point cloud classification and DTM](https://agisoft.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/31000148866-dense-cloud-classification), [DEM-based measurements](https://agisoft.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/31000148884-dem-based-measurements-)
* [Introduction to Structure from Motion Photogrammetry](https://opentopography.org/workshops/GSA2021), lectures and demos from the OpenTopography short course at GSA 2021 [@opentopography_2021_sfm], with the [YouTube playlist](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLYqCeHIaz7Pi2jpqsROsk064vmOsMPz9v)
* [Multi-View Stereo: A Tutorial](http://carlos-hernandez.org/papers/fnt_mvs_2015.pdf), the standard reference on dense matching [@furukawa_hernandez_2015]
